latencies.notes: Slope method (--unroll 100000, --unroll2 200000), three independent runs, raw spread 4.05-4.07 cycles; 1 cycles of ARMFLAGS helper latency subtracted where a chain closes through armmtflag/armmfflag. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

throughput.notes: Slope method, 8 independent lanes; 16.00 cycles per 8 instructions.

notes: Only ARMFLAGS is written: the general-purpose registers are read-only sources for this instruction (verified with a native test program, where armadd.w, armsub.w, armand.w, armmov.w, armrotr.w and armrrx.w leave every GPR unchanged while ARMFLAGS changes; the conditional move armMove is the exception and does write its destination).
